name: Kir-Lanan
traits: Medium Monstrous Humanoid. +4 Strength, +2 Dexterity, −2 Wisdom. Darkvision 60 ft., +3 natural armor, and +4 racial Hide. Space and reach 5 ft.
Land 30 ft. and fly 90 ft. with good maneuverability, which allows hovering under 3.5 aerial movement.
Two primary claws deal 1d4 piercing and slashing each before Strength. A full attack with a one-handed weapon can add one secondary claw at −5 and half the Strength bonus to damage.
Proficient with all simple weapons and light armor.

Four racial Hit Dice (4d8) give BAB +4, base Fortitude +1, Reflex +4, and Will +4, plus two chosen feats. Racial skill points are seven times (2 + Intelligence modifier, minimum 1). Racial class skills are Escape Artist, Hide, Listen, Move Silently, Spot, and Use Magic Device.

Negative Energy Touch (Su), 3/day. Make a melee touch attack or deliver it with a claw that hits normal AC. Deals 2d6 damage and 1 point of Strength damage. Fortitude DC 12 + Charisma modifier negates the Strength damage only. Heal HP equal to the energy damage dealt, up to maximum HP.
Ray of Enfeeblement (Sp), 3/day at caster level 4. Ranged touch within 35 ft. The target takes a 1d6+2 Strength penalty for 4 minutes, to a minimum score of 1. No save. Spell resistance applies.
Rebuke or command undead 3/day as an evil Cleric of a level equal to the Kir-Lanan’s total Hit Dice.
Cure spells, holy water, and blessed weapons affect a Kir-Lanan as they would undead. Inflict spells and other negative energy heal it. A Kir-Lanan is a living creature and cannot be turned.

Soulless. Cannot use positive energy or divine magic or take levels in Cleric, Druid, or Paladin. Ranger levels grant no spellcasting. A Bard can learn inflict spells in place of cure spells. Return from death requires wish or miracle.
Common and Kir-Lanan are automatic. Bonus languages are by region. Favored class Fighter. Level adjustment +4 gives ECL 8 before class levels.
This 3.5 profile uses the 2003 player traits. The 2004 monster conversion confirms the type, space, reach, and level adjustment.
